comments.text: In 2022 my wife was pregnant with our son. In April of 2022 they told us he was going to have issues. They told us that my wife was high risk, that he would likely have downs. We kept going, in August they did a late term ultrasound. They notified us that he had a brain hemorrhage, and that he had hydrocephalus. We were heart broken. They told us that we should consider an abortion, he would have a difficult life. We said no. They sent us to a specialist,we did a fetal mri. He said they would have to do surgery and that he would be in the nicu for at least 30 days. He said my son was missing a portion of his brain, including his cerebellum. He said he would have a hard life and he wouldn’t be able to speak, probably not walk. He described it as “I am expecting devastating results.” We stayed strong, took it as it came. Our son was born in October. He spend one night in the nicu, no surgery, no problems. He’s now 3 and a half and is totally normal kid who I love more than anything (except maybe his sister)
